description: Return one funder's plain-language profile, computed from active global observations. Each fact carries its public source name and the date it was last verified.

funder_slug.description: Public URL slug from a funder_search result. Not an internal database identifier.

name: funder_profile

items.description: Adding a value is a minor contract change; removing or renaming one is a major change (§38.2).
One plain-language fact with its public source. Never carries a score, tier, confidence or lineage.

last_verified_date.description: Most recent verification date across the facts shown.

size_band.description: Average annual giving over the last five reported years, in the funder's reporting currency. small is under 100,000; medium is 100,000 to 1,000,000; large is over 1,000,000; unknown means no public giving figure. Band limits are proposed and must be confirmed before G0 freeze.

website_url.description: The funder's own website, if public.

title: Get public funder profile
